user.title: Connect Cradlewise
user.description: Generate an API token in the Cradlewise web dashboard (left menu: **Cradlewise Data API** → **Generate**) and paste it here. Tokens are bound to one baby, so add the integration once per baby. A Nurture Plus subscription is required.

data_description.token: Starts with `cw_`. Only a baby's admin can generate a token, and it can't be created in the mobile app.

reauth_confirm.title: Cradlewise token expired
reauth_confirm.description: Cradlewise tokens are valid for 60 days. Generate a new token in the web dashboard and paste it here. Generating a new token invalidates the old one.

error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or has expired
error.no_subscription: A Nurture Plus subscription is required for the Cradlewise Data API
error.rate_limited: Rate limited by Cradlewise, try again in a minute

init.title: Polling intervals
init.description: The API allows 2 status requests per minute, 60 sleep requests per hour and 2,880 requests per day in total.
